import datetime,json,os,pathlib,re,shutil,subprocess
stage=pathlib.Path("/Users/me/Developer/household-snapshot-csv-c945953fdeb7")
target=pathlib.Path("/Users/me/Applications/HouseholdSnapshotCSV-c945953fdeb7")
receiver=pathlib.Path("/Users/me/Developer/household-snapshot-csv-receiving-c945953fdeb7")
v=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/vm_stat"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=5)
page=int(re.search(r"page size of (\d+) bytes",v.stdout).group(1))
memory=page*sum(int(re.search(r"^"+re.escape(k)+r":\s+(\d+)",v.stdout,re.M).group(1)) for k in ("Pages free","Pages inactive","Pages speculative"))
out={"utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"pid":os.getpid(),"free_disk":shutil.disk_usage(stage).free,"conservative_memory":memory,"disk_floor":256*1024**2,"memory_floor":2*1024**3,"stage_exists":stage.is_dir(),"target_exists":target.is_dir(),"receiver_absent":not os.path.lexists(receiver),"originals":[str(x.relative_to(stage)) for x in sorted((stage/"originals").rglob("*")) if x.is_file()],"writes":0,"product_invocations":0}
print(json.dumps(out))
assert out["free_disk"]>=out["disk_floor"] and memory>=out["memory_floor"] and out["receiver_absent"]
